fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Origin
fields.help: A stable, user-visible/meaningful string identifying the origin of the Lien, intended to be inspected programmatically.

fields.label: Parent
fields.help: A reference to the resource this Lien is attached to.

fields.label: Reason
fields.help: Concise user-visible strings indicating why an action cannot be performed on a resource.

fields.label: Restrictions
fields.help: The types of operations which should be blocked as a result of this Lien.
